title: Obsolete TLS/SSL version named (universal) — review required
description: Configuration or code names an obsolete protocol version: SSLv[23]b|TLSv1.[01]b. SSLv2/SSLv3 and TLS 1.0/1.1 are broken or deprecated; negotiating them exposes connections to known attacks. This lexical rule flags the name; the reviewer confirms it is documentation or removes it.
remediation: Require TLS 1.2+ only and drop the obsolete name.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the name regardless of context (code, config, or prose).
